questions.question: How, according to the passage, plunge in the economy devastated the life of the Americans?

options.A: it has led to huge loss of revenues amounting almost $14 trillion
options.B: due to degrading economy there has been voluminous cuts in spending
options.C: it has led to a wide scale increase in the number of people buying homes.

questions.explanation:
Refer to paragraph1, it is clearly mentioned that due to the degrading economy the states have made a cut on
spending and public workforces. Also there has been a sudden decrease in the number of people buying homes or
starting families. Hence both the options (b) and (c) are correct.

questions.question: What can be sighted as the prime cause of this economic slump?

options.A: changes in expansion plans and worker compensation.
options.B: the expansion in the Credit which has upheld the investment in manufacturing sector
options.C: the tight credit market which has resulted in the decline of real estate business
options.D: deregulation of the financial markets which has slowed down the economy
options.E: mismanagement of funds has led to huge confusion among the citizens

questions.explanation:
Read paragraph4 carefully, it is mentioned that the Americans have often responded with calls for regulation after
the financial sector-driven crises and have been accused of mismanagement. Hence deregulation is the major cause of
this economic slump.

questions.question:
Why have been the employers preferring part time jobs to regular full time jobs since the downfall in economy?
(I) to downslide the debt curtailed over the organizations
(II) so that more number of jobs can be raised from a single job
(III) because lots of jobs lost during the recession have not returned yet
questions.explanation:
Refer to paragraph5 of the passage, it is evident that many of the jobs lost during the recession have not returned
and due to that there has been a gradual increase in low wage and part-time jobs. Hence (b) is the correct choice.

questions.question: Home ownership has drastically decreased since the economic downturn. Explain.

options.A: because of the changes made in the Credit laws
options.B: due to the sudden shift in the nature of the federal towards the middle class Americans
options.C: due to sudden losss incurred in the real estate business of a large number of people
options.D: because people are making broad cuts in their spending

questions.explanation:
From the paragraph 2, we can easily infer that there is a decline in home ownership over the years as even in the
second quarter of the year, the U.S. homeownership rate was 65.1%, which is the lowest since 1995 as in the mid-2000s
it topped with 69%. Hence none of the options is correct in the context of the passage.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is/are NOT TRUE in the context of the passage?

options.A: federals are tightening the lending rules to avoid mistakes which inflated housing bubble lately
options.B: the U.S. economy could linger for decades due to this economic recession
options.C: there has been steep increase in low pay work to reduce unemployment slowly but steadily
options.D: even after a decade of the financial crash, the country is still struggling to recover

questions.explanation:
Read the passage, it is nowhere explicitly mentioned that after a decade of financial crash the economy is struggling
to recover, so statement (d) is clearly incorrect as it doesn’t relate to the content of the passage. Hence (d) is the correct
option.
